title: Flow builder: live preview for Screen nodes
body:
## Problem

The Screen node config (title / description / fields / object-form — expanded in #1927) is authored **blind**: there's no way to see what the screen will look like to the end user. The Debug simulator, when paused at a screen, shows only `paused` — it doesn't render the form. Screen flows are user-facing wizards, so designing a form without seeing it is error-prone (field order, labels, types, object-form layout).

## Proposal

A **live preview** that renders the screen as the end user would see it — title, description, the input `fields` (or the full object-form when `objectName` is set). Surface it in the node config panel and/or in the Debug simulator when paused at a screen. Reuse the **runtime** `ScreenSpec` renderer (and `plugin-form`/`ObjectForm` for object-form mode) so the preview matches runtime exactly.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Preview reflects `title`, `description` (with `{var}` interpolation), `fields`, and object-form mode (`objectName`/`defaults`).
- [ ] Updates live as the node config changes.
- [ ] Reuses the runtime screen/form renderer (not a separate reimplementation — avoids design↔runtime drift, cf. the simulator divergence fixed in #1927).

## Pointers

- The flow-runner renders the `ScreenSpec` at runtime (the engine's `screen` executor emits it) — reuse that renderer.
- `inspectors/flow-node-config.ts` — `screen` config group.
- `plugin-form` `ObjectForm` for object-form mode.
- `previews/FlowSimulatorPanel.tsx` — the paused-at-screen state where a preview would also fit.
